title: Format for Transmission of HD-D5 Compressed Video and Audio Data over 360 Mb/s Serial Digital Interface
scope: This practice defines the data stream used for synchronous transmission of HD-D5 compressed video and audio data over 360 Mb/s serial digital interface (SDI) for the 525/60 system as defined in ANSI/SMPTE 259M. This practice does not define data stream structure applicable for transmission over the serial data transport interface (SDTI), SMPTE 305M.
